feed.title: Etienne Cheynet | News
feed.subtitle: Academic website of Etienne Cheynet, Associate Professor at the University of Bergen. Research in atmospheric turbulence, wind engineering, experimental meteorology, offshore wind energy, bridge aerodynamics, and remote sensing.

entry.title: Bendik Voldseth completes his MSc
entry.content: Congratulations to Bendik Voldseth, who defended his MSc thesis at the University of Bergen on 30 October 2026. His research examined extreme weather events and insurance risk assessment for wind farms. See completed MSc supervision.
entry.summary: Congratulations to Bendik Voldseth, who defended his MSc thesis at the University of Bergen on 30 October 2026. His research examined extreme weather events and insurance risk assessment for wind farms. See completed MSc supervision.

entry.title: LOLLEX offshore wind measurements published
entry.content: Our LOLLEX paper is out in Atmospheric Measurement Techniques. It documents how ship- and platform-mounted lidars were used to study flow within an operating offshore wind farm. The associated lidar datasets are available on Zenodo.

entry.title: New preprint on offshore wind-turbine performance

link.title: New preprint on offshore wind-turbine performance

entry.content: A new preprint led by Rebeca Marini investigates how atmospheric conditions affect power production at an offshore wind turbine in the Belgian North Sea.
entry.summary: A new preprint led by Rebeca Marini investigates how atmospheric conditions affect power production at an offshore wind turbine in the Belgian North Sea.

entry.title: Zuhir Jamaleh completes his MSc
entry.content: Congratulations to Zuhir Jamaleh, who defended his MSc thesis at the University of Bergen on 19 June 2026. His thesis investigates an alternative turbulence-coherence model for the design of a 22 MW offshore wind turbine.
entry.summary: Congratulations to Zuhir Jamaleh, who defended his MSc thesis at the University of Bergen on 19 June 2026. His thesis investigates an alternative turbulence-coherence model for the design of a 22 MW offshore wind turbine.

entry.title: UiB joins the European Academy of Wind Energy

link.title: UiB joins the European Academy of Wind Energy

entry.content: The University of Bergen became a member of the European Academy of Wind Energy (EAWE) on 2 June 2026, joining its network for wind-energy research and education.

entry.title: Mathilde Bøkevoll completes her MSc
entry.content: Congratulations to Mathilde Bøkevoll, who defended her MSc thesis at the University of Bergen on 1 June 2026. Her thesis analyses the wind flow downstream of a parabolic trough solar collector array.
entry.summary: Congratulations to Mathilde Bøkevoll, who defended her MSc thesis at the University of Bergen on 1 June 2026. Her thesis analyses the wind flow downstream of a parabolic trough solar collector array.

entry.title: Turbulence coherence at DeepWind 2026
entry.content: Zuhir Ahmad Jamaleh presented our study of turbulence coherence for the IEA 22 MW reference wind turbine at DeepWind 2026.
